title: Document AGREE raw Z output and KDF requirement
description: In docs/programmers_guide.md ECDH section: add a prominent warning that DO_AGREE returns the raw X coordinate of the ECDH result (Z value per SP 800-56A). Callers MUST derive keying material from Z using an approved KDF (HKDF per RFC 5869 or SP 800-56C) before using it as a key. Using raw Z directly as a key is not SP 800-56A compliant and may void FIPS coverage. Include a short code example showing HKDF wrapping of the DO_AGREE output. Cite SP 800-56A Rev 3 Section 5.8. Also add a note to DESIGN.md recording this as a deliberate design decision (raw Z, KDF is caller responsibility) and why (KDF is protocol-specific).
close_reason: Added SP 800-56A Rev 3 §5.8 citation, explicit no-double-KDF warning in programmers_guide.md DO_AGREE section, expanded DESIGN.md rationale with why KDF is provider responsibility
